name: Rosewood Hotel Georgia
positioning: Historic downtown Vancouver hotel, opened in 1927 and reopened in 2011, directly across from the Vancouver Art Gallery
best_for: Travelers who want a central downtown Vancouver base with history
Food and cocktail lovers who want several restaurants and bars under one roof

facts.text: The hotel reopened in 2011 after a renovation that expanded the size of the existing rooms.
Errol Flynn was booked into the Georgia for his final hotel stay.
1927 Lounge offers refined fare and crafted cocktails amid local art and live music.
The Georgia Bar offers cocktails and small bites as well as whiskey tastings.
Bel Cafe comes from the kitchen of Chef David Hawksworth and serves handcrafted beverages and freshly baked pastries.
The Lord Stanley suite has a private rooftop terrace, a hot tub and a fireplace.
The hotel's spa is Sense, A Rosewood Spa.
The hotel offers a whale watching adventure with Prince of Whales to see orcas and humpbacks.

highlights.text: Past guests include Nat King Cole, Louis Armstrong, Elvis and John Wayne.
Hawksworth is a 2024 Michelin Guide-recommended restaurant.
Signature suites have a private rooftop space with a plunge pool and an al fresco dining area.
Reflections The Garden Terrace serves seasonal cuisine and tapas-style dishes with locally inspired cocktails under the open sky.
The hotel is directly across from the Vancouver Art Gallery.

considerations.text: Reflections, the outdoor terrace, is open from April to October, plus a brief stint around the winter holidays.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the hotel's exclusive positioning.
